title: Floors and tables
intro: Floors and tables define the dine-in layout used when staff select a table before taking orders.

sections.title: Floors
steps: Create floor plans for each dining area (e.g. Main, Patio).
Floors appear on the table-selection step when floor mode is enabled.
sections.caption: Floors tab.

sections.title: Tables
sections.intro: Each table belongs to a floor and carries a name or number used on checks and kitchen tickets.
steps: Add tables with capacity and floor assignment.
Edit or deactivate tables when the floor plan changes.
sections.caption: Tables tab.

sections.intro: Pertence a piso; pode restringir categorias e pagamentos.
